definitions.explanation: Something placed alongside a main item to go with it or set it off, such as a garnish or side vegetables on a plate, or a small extra included with a purchase.
A person or thing that is only an add-on to what really matters, with no importance of its own. Often said with a note of complaint or self-deprecation.

examples.japanese: ⟦パセリ→パセリ：21585_paseri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}だ。
examples.english: The parsley is just a garnish.

examples.japanese: ⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{温野菜|おんやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared steamed vegetables to go with the steak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{残|のこ}さ→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ず⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate everything on the plate, even the garnish at the edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: In this film, the love story is merely an afterthought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{話|はな}さなかった→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I was called to the meeting, but in the end I was only there as the manager's tag-along and never said a word.

notes:
From ⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧ (to add, to attach) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}: an accompaniment to ~
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{添|そ}え{物|もの}: a mere add-on
- {添|そ}え{物|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: to be nothing more than an extra

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ→付け合わせ：08257_tsukeawase⟧: side vegetables served with a main dish — the specific cooking term for sense 1
- ⟦おまけ→おまけ：08160_omake⟧: a free extra with a purchase; also "bonus" in a lighter tone than sense 2
